gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads contemporary and unfussy, with a high mean line and curves that stay open at their ends. Stencilia above it is structural and striking.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-choras: Noto Sans Chorasmian has a large x-height and curves that stop short instead of closing, under Stencilia's display headings. It reads smoothly and steadily down a page.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-cuneif: Stencilia's spacious gaps at its curve terminals make a striking, structural heading, while Noto Sans Cuneiform swells its lowercase like glass beads. Reading it feels clean and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-elymai: Structural and striking up top, then quietly modern below. Stencilia leaves generous gaps at its curve terminals, and Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open throughout.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic has lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads and round forms like open parentheses. Noto Sans Gothic gives Stencilia's striking display heading a modern, spacious partner.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-gujara: Noto Sans Gujarati reads clean and open, its curves ending before they turn inward. Stencilia's striking display heading sits above it, structural where the body is airy and generous.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-hanuno: Stencilia has a compact gap between its x-height and ascender line, giving headings a structural look. Noto Sans Hanunoo adds lowercase that fills most of the height, with open terminals that are easy to follow.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-hk: Clean and professional is how Noto Sans HK looks, with large lowercase forms and brush ends lifted away before curves close. Stencilia adds striking structure with its spacious gaps at curve terminals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-imperi: Striking up top, approachable below. Shrink Stencilia and its spacious curve gaps would crowd, while Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps the c's two ends pointing apart.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-noto-sans-kannad: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Kannada, with s curves opening wide at both ends. And under Stencilia's striking headings, its gentle bump up to capitals keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
